descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S22 Probe, Nursing-Home-shaped chart: a stored unit, street address and phone come back unchanged from Ask AI (guardrail PHONE/ADDRESS = None)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on. (UAT OAT-05; UAT 3.1; TFA-94059 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Local stack as in S21 (guardrail ID and version recorded by name; negative control run once). A resident record whose pre-round note holds a unit, a facility unit, a street address and a phone number in detector-confirmed forms. …

When Ask 'Which unit is the resident on, where is she going after discharge, and what is her son's phone number?' through ai/assist:askChart

Then The answer names Unit G-24, 123 Main Street and (217) 555-0142 as stored. There is no {ADDRESS} or {PHONE} token.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 7 (ADDRESS/PHONE = None). As S21: a token is a Fail, a stored value missing from the answer is a Fail (quoted), and the probe counts only with S27 and S28 passing in the same run and a failed negative control. The answering model is recorded (3.9).

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
